eventMetadata.context_description: Silver (XAG/USD) trades near $58 per ounce amid persistent industrial demand from solar, EVs, and electronics that continues to exceed mine supply, supporting structural deficits. Trader focus centers on the July 28-29 FOMC meeting, where a rates hold is widely expected while markets price in later policy easing that could ease real yields and support precious metals. Recent price action reflects a pullback from earlier 2026 highs, with sensitivity to U.S. dollar strength, Treasury yields, and any revisions to inflation or labor data. The gold-silver ratio and risk sentiment also influence positioning ahead of the resolution window.
